description: Get a coarse availability forecast (Low/Mid/High) for a product family and period. `synthetic` tells whether the bucket comes from a live ad-server forecast.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key for replay detection — required on every call unless the operator opted out; fresh value per call

token.description: Buyer bearer JWT (RS256, aud=seller-mcp-node). Identity is derived from token.sub.

name: get_forecast
